note: LEADS.md Part U U5, TEST_LEDGER.md T-1070: stage ablation ladder of the F16 prompt-expert kernel. BENCH ONLY: every arm except base is a binary built with -DSTRATA_BENCH_ABLATION and STRATA_ABL_* macros (src/prefill/moe_f16_ablate.cuh) that REMOVE ONE STAGE, so the text is wrong by design and only prompt tok/s is read (no drift check of text, no quality gate). Arms: base = the engine unchanged; noload, nodeq, nowiden, nostore, noread, nowmma, noepi = one stage removed; cum2..cum7 = the stages removed one after another in ladder order (cum1 is noload, cum7 has every stage removed). Build and run with tools/pancake/box_chains/bench-ablate-f16.sh (one build directory, two translation units recompiled per variant, binaries copied to /mnt/pancake/ablate-f16/bin/<arm>/strata); read with python3 tools/pancake/f16_ablate.py report <run1.jsonl> <run2.jsonl>. STRATA_PF_F16=1 is set in every arm (the preset's PF_F16=2 is the F16-off path, T-820). long3k is the control (T-820: no F16 gain there), long / long32k / long64k are where the kernel is worth +15-17%. Two runs, never one (owner protocol 2026-11-20).
